headline: US stocks rose on Thursday even as AI shares swung sharply, with the S&P 500 up 0.3% and the Dow gaining 556 points.
score_reason: Standard daily market wrap from the AP, useful as the day's record; facts match the pool score.
importance_line: Investors in broad US stock funds were cushioned by earnings, while AI-heavy shares and their lenders remain exposed to borrowing costs; the AP describes the swings but does not say whether they have ended.
summary: The Associated Press reports that US indexes climbed on stronger-than-expected company profits after a sell-off in AI stocks that began on Wednesday had sent South Korea's Kospi down 7.6% and Japan's Nikkei down 4.9%. The AP says worries are growing about how long the AI spending boom can last, because many companies borrowed to pay for data centres and chips just as bond yields reached their highest levels in years.
